idea_name: Adaptive digital-filter oscillator bank for DNN inputs
mechanism: From OHLCV build FATL/SATL/RFTL/RSTL FIR DigFiltr on Close; derive FTLM=fatl−rftl, STLM=satl−rstl, RBCI=fatl−satl, PCCI=Close−fatl plus first differences v.*; clean zv/nzv/corr; IQR cap outliers; feed Class=sign(ZigZag Δ) lead-1 as binary target.

quote: Digital filters FATL, SATL, RFTL, RSTL will play that role.

idea_name: Train-only IQR/LOF outlier bounds for streaming filter features
mechanism: prep.outlier on train bars stores lower=Q1−1.5IQR, upper=Q3+1.5IQR, cap 5%/95%; treatOutlier applies same bounds to test/val (impute caps or NA). Rlof/LOF marks global multivariate outliers (~lof≥1.6).
data_needed: Train split of filter features; saved pre.outl parameters for live apply.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURJPY M15 feature matrix (~7906 clean rows after NA drop)
why_new_for_mis: Operationalizes leakage-safe outlier sensing so MIS can flag anomalous filter-state vectors online using frozen train bounds.
quote: To identify the range limits, exceeding which the observation will be treated as an outlier, one should use a training data set.

idea_name: Goal-aware MDLP/smbinning discretization of filter states
mechanism: mdlp() entropy+MDL cutpoints on train map continuous ftlm/rbci/v.fatl/… into 2–4 Class-linked bins; smbinning IV ranks predictors (v_fatl, ftlm, v_satl, rbci strong); unlabeled 'All' vars (stlm, v.rstl, v.pcci) dropped; findInterval applies train cuts to val/test.
data_needed: Cleaned predictor matrix + binary Class; mdlp cutp; IV>0.1 keep list.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURJPY M15; train/val/test 2000/1000/1000 bars from Part I set
why_new_for_mis: Converts continuous filter readings into discrete Class-conditioned regime bins MIS can log as categorical market-state codes.
quote: This function discretizes continuous attributes of the matrix by the entropy criterion with the minimal description length as the stopping rule.
